rows.desktop_responsibility: Pins the mandatory offline ASR engine provenance/model inputs consumed by Desktop exact-source packaging so shipping voice-input transcription has a local engine with auditable source identity.
rows.desktop_visible_effect: Voice input can be transcribed locally without a network transcription dependency, and the shipping ASR implementation has an explicit provenance boundary.
rows.ios_platform_delta: iOS uses the native Speech framework with requiresOnDeviceRecognition=true instead of a macOS whisper-cli bundle; AVFoundation VoiceRecorder remains the single microphone-capture owner and unsupported on-device recognition fails closed.
rows.notes: Desktop mechanism is replaced, not the product effect. Agent/Bot voice input transcribes locally into the editable draft and never auto-sends; Human voice-message capture continues to reuse VoiceRecorder.
